name: observational-memory
description: Observational memory for pi — project-scoped, subprocess-backed memory: parallel observers distill the conversation into a session ledger; a consolidator promotes established observations into the shared .memory/project/ bank (INDEX.md, OVERVIEW.md, topic files) reused by every session in the cwd, with per-session archives under .memory/sessions/ and transient worker IPC under .memory/runtime/.
